title: Casual Netherite & Smithing Templates
description: Adds recipes for netherite scrap, smithing upgrade templates, and copying smithing templates for people who just want to play more casually.
body:
Adds recipes for netherite scrap, smithing upgrade templates, and copying smithing templates for people who just want to play more casually. I figured getting your hands on scute is enough of a pain to make up for the expensive vanilla recipe.

Created using [Crafting Recipe Generator](https://crafting.thedestruc7i0n.ca/)

Inspired by the archived datapack [Overworld Netherite](https://modrinth.com/datapack/overnetherite/gallery) by [Kotyarendj](https://modrinth.com/user/Kotyarendj)
